date:ezra-reads-the-law@570463.note: Seventh month follows the wall's Elul finish (6:15) in the twentieth-year sequence (2:1). The BC year depends on dating Artaxerxes' reign outside Scripture.

date:nehemiah-rebuilds-the-walls@570463.note: Work begins in Nisan of Artaxerxes' twentieth year (2:1) and the wall is finished in 52 days (6:15). The BC year depends on dating the reign outside Scripture.

date:nehemiah-s-second-term@94bd82.note: Nehemiah returns in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes (13:6). The BC year depends on dating the king's reign outside Scripture.

member-of:eliashib_1100>tribe-of-levi@08.note: Named high priest (3:1), and his line is among the Levites' recorded fathers (12:22-23). Priests descending from Levi is inferred, not stated.

member-of:jaddua_687>tribe-of-levi@a4fec.note: Listed among the Levites' recorded chief fathers in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan and Jaddua (12:22). Membership is inferred from that list.

member-of:johanan_1698>tribe-of-levi@84e.note: 12:22 lists him among the Levites' chief fathers; 12:23 cites the sons of Levi up to his days. Levite membership is inferred, not stated.

member-of:joiada_1680>tribe-of-levi@d006.note: 12:22 lists Joiada among the Levites' chief fathers; he is a priest in Eliashib's line (13:28). Levite membership is inferred.

member-of:joiakim_1681>tribe-of-levi@814.note: His father Jeshua is named with the priests and Levites (12:1). The Levite line through Jeshua is inferred for Joiakim, not stated.

member-of:son_of_joiada_2768>tribe-of-le.note: He is a son of the priest Joiada (13:28), and 13:29 speaks of those who defiled the priesthood. Levite membership is inferred.

occurred-at:ezra-reads-the-law>jerusalem.note: The reading is in the street before the water gate (8:1), a Jerusalem gate per 3:26 and 12:37. Jerusalem is not named in 8:1, so this is a reading.

occurred-at:nehemiah-rebuilds-the-walls>.note: Nehemiah urges them to build up 'the wall of Jerusalem' (2:17), and the wall is finished (6:15).

occurred-at:nehemiah-s-second-term>jerus.note: 'And I came to Jerusalem' (13:7), where the second-term reforms take place.

participated-in:ezra_1245>ezra-reads-the.note: Ezra brings the law (8:2), reads it aloud (8:3) and opens the book (8:5).

participated-in:nehemiah_2172>nehemiah-r.note: He urges the building (2:17) and says 'I continued in the work of this wall' (5:16).
